title: SK Hynix expects memory shortages to persist through at least 2030; it has long-term deals with 14 major buyers for 50%+ of its output in 2027 and 2028 (Simon Sharwood/The Register)
summary: Simon Sharwood / The Register: SK Hynix expects memory shortages to persist through at least 2030; it has long-term deals with 14 major buyers for 50%+ of its output in 2027 and 2028 — Korean memory-maker SK Hynix has predicted memory shortages will persist until at least the year 2030 and says that will help it to boost …
